dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Mild traumatic brain injury (concussion) from an unwitnessed fall or blunt head impact, with transient loss of consciousness and post-traumatic amnesia

Alternative 1: Syncope causing a secondary fall and head injury

Alternative 2: First generalized epileptic seizure with a postictal amnestic period

Alternative 3: Psychogenic nonepileptic episode with secondary injury
